description: Operational automation policy for the MUSIC OS 360 operational agents and skills: how runs execute, what they must record and what they must report as unavailable. Consumers: operational agents, audit-automation-run, record-automation-evidence and the operational-automation gate.
rules: every run resolves its tenant explicitly and executes inside the tenant context
writes go through the guarded product services and never directly to the database
every step is idempotent or carries an idempotency key
a checkpoint is recorded before each high-impact step
every completed run has evidence references
unknown or missing data is reported as unknown and never filled with an invented value
a capability whose provider is not configured returns CAPABILITY_UNAVAILABLE with its expected contract and a safe fallback
retries are bounded and never applied to non-idempotent steps
operational agents propose and prepare; execution of a high-impact step happens only after a recorded approval bound to its payload
